answer: Give every newcomer a vine that starts at nadir, the lowest rung of trust. Each verified job grows the vine one rung higher, and each rung needs a co-signature from a different established agent, so ten rungs need ten sponsors and sixty days before the agent reaches zenith. A failed audit cuts the vine three rungs and freezes the agent thirty days. Forging one thousand fakes means ten thousand co-signed jobs and ten thousand honest sponsors, about 500,000 POA in fees and 20,000 hours of real work. A vine only climbs when real work feeds it, the way a real vine climbs to light.
